request.title: Install Amendment B standing engineering policy authorization
request.problem: Normal engineering repeatedly stalls on per-change owner approval and exported personal sessions. The current renewable workload is valid but has metadata-only authority; it must not invent its own release grant.
request.expected_behavior: Release b934aaa4609f19dd7ac8f30bcbbb78b36375d4db; manifest 8947072af76f37042b2baed2ffaf67378f6cfae69f036f53db4a4fa2afe4a251. Install only the pinned Control/runtime and additive security migrations after the separately approved owner-session repair. Apply the frozen standing-policy declaration through the protected authenticated administrative installer after genuine owner approval. No further owner browser or per-change Controller approval is required for eligible routine work.
request.change_purpose: Implement the owner-directed permanent autonomous authority policy through legitimate, durable, scoped and revocable standing delegation.
request.feature_improvement: Automatically admit eligible routine releases using normal renewable workload Auth, exact source and CI, budget and scope checks, audit, component locks, rollback and independent source readback.
regression_rules: The executing workload cannot create or expand its own authority. Only the protected Management installer may apply the exact declaration already approved by the real owner.
Preserve every owner approval, revocation and execution event; never manufacture an owner Auth session or audit record.
Preserve the deployed V4 32, workspace 46 and WhatsApp 163, customer data, Gmail, email/WhatsApp/voice processing, memory ingestion and the existing pilot allowlist.
Preserve mandatory provider protections, CI, source verification, scoped permissions, idempotency and rollback.

Initial authority: existing bound engineering identity only; V4/workspace canary; low/normal risk; until revoked or the parent grant expires; at most ten releases/day; no new resource spending. Normal Auth sessions and release admissions remain short-lived.

Preserve deployed engineering runtime 15 and its lifecycle recovery routing. Use unique migration history versions 20261022110000, 20261022111000 and 20261022112000; approved SQL remains byte-identical.
acceptance_criteria: Latest independent runtime, source-admission and transport tests plus 31 isolated PostgreSQL assertions pass.
Verify the genuine owner approval and declaration digest before administrative provisioning; verify actual deployed source and grant revision afterwards.
Certify two unattended production cycles, expiry/revocation, target/risk/source denials and rollback before claiming operational autonomy.
Do not mark SANDY-ENG-0001 complete before all four channels and the required quality cohort pass.
